title: Replace a medical record book
summary: Registered combatants can apply online to replace a damaged, lost, stolen, not received, or full medical record book.
intro: As a registered combatant you can apply online to replace your medical record book if yours has been damaged, lost, stolen, not received or is full.
what_you_need: Completed Statutory Declaration (signed by a Justice of the Peace, Notary Public, or Legal Practitioner)

how_to_steps.text: Gather the required details and documents.
Log in to your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to apply for a replacement medical record book.

more_info.text: If you need to update your details, go to Change name or contact details on a combatant registration.
You must take your medical record book to all contests you participate in and show it to the attending medical practitioner.
To check your combatant registration number and details, visit Verify NSW.

internal_links.text: Change name or contact details on a combatant registration
Manage classes on a combatant registration
Update medical documents for a combatant registration

faqs.q: Who can apply to replace a medical record book?
faqs.a: Registered combatants can apply online to replace their medical record book.

faqs.q: What is required to replace a medical record book?
faqs.a: You need a MyServiceNSW Account, your combatant registration number, a completed Statutory Declaration (signed by a Justice of the Peace, Notary Public, or Legal Practitioner), and payment.

faqs.q: Is a Statutory Declaration always required?
faqs.a: The completed statutory declaration is required, but it is not needed if you are replacing a full book.
